name: Nairobi Health Research Ethics Committee Reaccredited

content.title: Nairobi Health Research Ethics Committee Reaccredited
content.summary: The Health Research Ethics Committee, REC at Nairobi of Aga Khan University, in East Africa, has been reaccredited for another three years, until March 2018, by the National Commission for Science, Technology and Innovation (NACOSTI).

media.alt: Nairobi Health Research Ethics Committee Reaccredited

content.text: "In late April 2015, the Health Research Ethics Committee, REC at Nairobi of Aga Khan University, in East Africa, was reaccredited for another three years, until March 2018, by the National Commission for Science, Technology and Innovation(NACOSTI).

NACOSTI is a national government institution with a mandate to regulate and assure quality in the science, technology, and innovation sector and to advise the Government in matters related to these areas (www.nacosti.go.ke). The renewal of accreditation was recommended by the National Bioethics Committee of Kenya after its assessment of the committee's past performance.

In 2014, the REC reviewed 76 health proposals for ethical clearance ensuring that all ethical aspects were comprehensively covered and basic rights of research participants would not be compromised by the proposed research.  The majority of the proposals - 57 per cent - were submitted by postgraduate medical and nursing students who are required to do so when formulating their research thesis.  By its recommendation, the National Bioethics Committee asserted that the REC has clearly demonstrated capabilities in reviewing the ethical aspects of health research proposals that involve human participants and should continue its work.

The Health Research Ethics Committee in Kenya comprises 12 members and is chaired by Dr. Amyn Lakhani, a member of the Faculty of Health Sciences, AKU East Africa, who is supported by Ms. Ciru Kamanda. The members, whose backgrounds include the legal, medical, pharmaceutical, and religious professions, among others, contribute their perspectives to facilitate thoughtful discussions and well-informed decision-making."
